item.text:
“the stakes for our coverage has never been higher” >>> “the stakes for our coverage have never been higher”
“federal goverment's” >>> “federal government's”
“more then ever” >>> “more than ever”
“has three cosponsors on the committee, Senators Okafor and Lindqvist” >>> [CHECK: Three cosponsors are claimed, but only two are named.]
“it's definitions” >>> “its definitions”
“its central principal” >>> “its central principle”
“enforcment regime” >>> “enforcement regime”
“would directly effect every company” >>> “would directly affect every company”
“Senator Whitfield (R-OK)” >>> [CHECK: Whitfield is identified as R-OH earlier. Verify the state.]
“narrows the registry in Section 5” >>> “narrows the registry in Section 4”
“keeps the $10 million daily civil penalty in Section 5” >>> [CHECK: The bill summary gives a $1 million daily civil penalty. Verify the amount and whether the amendment retains or changes it.]
“who's support” >>> “whose support”
“the amendment's changes is modest” >>> “the amendment's changes are modest”
“of the committees 28 members” >>> “of the committee's 28 members”
“13 are yes or leaning yes, 10 are no or leaning no, and 6 are undecided” >>> [CHECK: These counts total 29, not the stated 28 committee members.]
“The undecided senators are Chen, Ellis, Alvarez, Pike, and Barlow” >>> [CHECK: Only five senators are listed, but the preceding sentence says six are undecided.]
“Thursday, October 14” >>> “Thursday, October 15”
“after the September 23 hearing” >>> [CHECK: The timeline dates the committee hearing to September 30. Verify whether these are different hearings or one date is wrong.]
“Senator Kowalski, who withdrew his cosponsorship on October 2, has not committed to voting no; in a seperate interview, Senator Ames said he has not made a final decision either” >>> [CHECK: Clarify whether Kowalski and Ames are undecided; neither appears in the undecided list.]
“in a seperate interview” >>> “in a separate interview”
“The list of undecided senators, along with their staff contacts, are attached” >>> “The list of undecided senators, along with their staff contacts, is attached”
“Commerce Commitee markup” >>> “Commerce Committee markup”
“as soon as the week November 16” >>> “as soon as the week of November 16”
“occured on September 30” >>> “occurred on September 30”
“the treaty negotiations required by Section 6 would have to conclude within two years” >>> [CHECK: The bill summary specifies an international agreement within 18 months, not two years. Verify both the deadline and what must be completed.]
“a close compliment to S. 2817” >>> “a close complement to S. 2817”
“Our six Hill reporters” / “Each of our five Hill reporters” >>> [CHECK: Verify whether there are five or six Hill reporters, or explain the different assignments.]
“with the the offices” >>> “with the offices”
“to there senators” >>> “to their senators”
“should recieve updated notes” >>> “should receive updated notes”
